status: pre-registered before any finalist live job (no finalist live job has been submitted)
contract: CONTRACT A20 (phase 3), A13.2/A13.3 and addendum; validation only: live results never change a finalist, the headline, any pre-registered number or facts/finalists.json

deployment.shape: one whole 8xH100 SXM node per job, N = 4 vLLM 0.24.0 workers x TP2, Qwen3-32B, aggregated; frontend with the embedded KV router; recipe benchmarks/learned_routing/live/deploy (job_node.sh pairs mode)
deployment.worker_count_decision: N = 4 only: every needed family/mode has frozen N = 4 test cells; the two-node N = 8 path is scripted but untested and would double node cost per run, so it is not worth the GPU time here

policy_notes: exactly the frozen specs: finalists.json learned_headline_pool.m1v2 (headline arm) and .m1, tuned_baselines.ramjet (val-best baseline) and .m0, plus builtins default@defaults and round_robin; spec file benchmarks/learned_routing/live/deploy/specs/finalists.json
every planned YAML is byte-identical to the YAML the frozen test pass replayed at k0 (file name = sha256; ramjet is unseeded)
default@defaults runs twice per cell (labels default_a, default_b) with distinct salts, to measure live run-to-run noise at fixed k
cell_choice: frozen test cells at N = 4 (held-out by time window, family or workload draw), one or two per supported family and load mode: Mooncake open (L2, L3) and closed (L3), FAST25 conversation and synthetic (open; FAST25 closed exists only at N = 8), synthetic sessions (open, multi-turn; sessions closed exists only at N = 8); no AgentX (no live load generator)

loadgen parity: Mooncake open/closed and synthetic sessions open are exact in the CPU parity audit and the GPU smoke ran Mooncake open; conv-w3-base-n4-open-L2 and fast25_synthetic-x0-base-n4-open-L2 are among the 13 statically audited cells (exact; fast25_synthetic has 7 tie groups / 14 requests whose order live cannot enforce)
transform cells (islp2.5, osl4.0, 27-29 min per run) and sessions-s6-think4.0 (65 min) were trimmed for time; sessions-s9-base-n4-open-L1 not added (36 min per run, at ceiling in sim like s6)

sessions-s6 is at ceiling in simulation (ramjet, m1v2, m1, m0 within 0.3%): it checks the ceiling and the default and round-robin gaps live, and is excluded from the M1-v2 vs ramjet sign test by the informativeness rule below
salt_rule: salt = lrfin-<cell>-<label>-k0-a<attempt>; a re-run takes the next attempt number and a fresh input directory <cell>__<label>__a<attempt>; idle E0 inputs lrfin-idle-<pack>-k0-a1

run_order.rule: per cell, seed = int(sha256('lr-live-order-v1|<cell_id>')[:16], 16); order = random.Random(seed).sample(labels, 7) over [default_a, default_b, ramjet, m1v2, m1, m0, round_robin] (CPython random); a split cell keeps that order within each half; the idle E0 calibration (when present) runs last

scheduling.budget: about 8 h wall for the whole matrix, at most 4 concurrent 8-GPU jobs (GPU cluster interactive allows 2 concurrent 1-node jobs of <= 2 h; batch allows 4 h but was estimated to start about 3.7 h after submission at registration time)
scheduling.est_rule: est_s per run = ceil(1.05 x replay makespan of that policy at k0 + 45 s); job_node.sh skips (never truncates) a pair whose est_s + pair_margin_s no longer fits before the job's end
scheduling.interactive_pack_note: P1-P3 have about 0-4 min of slack under the conservative est_s; at the smoke's measured ratios (live wall 1.021 x makespan + 24 s, about 45-60 s of switch and checks per pair) they need about 100-102 min of work plus 5.5 min setup, inside 1 h 55 min; a final pair that the guard skips is re-run under the rerun rule

acceptance_job.name: P0-accept
acceptance_job.what: one interactive job, --time 00:30:00, no payload, --policies with all six plan slugs: builds the wheel and venv for the staged commit and runs every policy's check unit (wait, smoke with policy_evidence, cold reset) on 8 GPUs before any 7-run pack is spent

suggested_waves: wave 0: P0-accept; continue only if every policy's check is ok
wave 1: P1-conv and P2-fsyn on interactive (immediate start); P5-mcopenL2 and P4-mcopenL3 on batch

when an interactive slot frees: P3-mcclosed; then P6-sessA and P7-sessB on batch (or, if batch has not started within 60 min while an interactive slot is idle, run the P4/P5 fallback halves on interactive)
the first job builds the wheel and venv for the staged commit; build_env.sh makes concurrent jobs wait for that build
scheduling.first_job_gpu_acceptance: the first job's check phases are the GPU acceptance of every live policy type (learned-choice feature_set v2 and v1, ramjet, dynamo-default-cost-fn with parameters, round_robin): policy_evidence must pass for each before its run is used; a check_failed pair is fixed and re-run, it never silently drops a policy
scheduling.trim_order: if the budget or scheduler cannot fit the matrix, drop whole cells in this order: sessions-s6-base-n4-open-L2 (P6/P7), then mooncake-w5-base-n4-open-L3 (P4); never drop a policy from a cell that runs
scheduling.rerun_rule: a pair whose status is not ok, or whose score has fidelity_ok false, is re-run once with a new salt (attempt 2), preferably in a pack that holds the same cell's defaults; if it still fails, that (cell, policy) is missing and reported

scoring.adapter: benchmarks/learned_routing/live/score_live.py score (harness goodput.compute_metrics: the A2 rule, the cell's SLA, measure window and warm-up, occupancy rule)
scoring.primary_metric: goodput_rps_window under the AIS E0 (ais-chunked-estimator-v2), the simulator's own reference
scoring.validity: a run counts only if score_live reports fidelity_ok (every request matched, exact prompts, ISL and forced OSL, usage, session headers) and the pair status is ok; AIPerf's empty-detokenization OSL=1 errors count as not good, as the scorer does, and are reported
secondary: A19 good_tokens_rps_window over the same in-window requests and good rule
goodput under the live-idle E0 (score --e0 live), fitted on the pooled idle calibration runs of the finalist jobs (plus each node's own fit as a sensitivity)
TTFT p50/p90, mean-ITL p50/p90, prefix-cache hit rate, per-worker request share (LR-13 cap 0.5 at N = 4) and schedule lateness, descriptive

sim_counterparts.rule: same cell, N = 4, load, frozen spec and CRN replicate k = 0 (policy seed 1) on the tuning build 6955b0ee; all 108 (k0-2) were cache hits on the frozen test pass, so no test cell was replayed
sim_counterparts.secondary: mean over k0-2; the robustness pass's lag 10/50/200 ms k0 records (round_robin has no lag records; it reads no router state)

analysis.live_default_reference: D(c, p) = mean goodput of the default@defaults runs in the same job as p (both defaults when they share p's job, as in every unsplit pack)
paired_deltas: vs default: dDef_live(c, p) = s(g_live(c, p), D(c, p)) for p in {ramjet, m1v2, m1, m0, round_robin}; sim: dDef_sim(c, p) = s(g_sim_k0(c, p), g_sim_k0(c, default))

vs ramjet: dRj_live(c, p) = s(g_live(c, p), g_live(c, ramjet)) for p in {m1v2, m1, m0, round_robin, default (=D)}; flagged cross-node when p and ramjet ran in different jobs (never for m1v2, by the split rule)
per cell, and the mean over cells with its range; no significance claims (6 cells at most)
kendall_tau: per cell: Kendall tau-b between dDef_sim(c, .) and dDef_live(c, .) over the 6 policies (default fixed at 0)
pooled (primary pooled): tau-b between the per-policy means over cells of dDef_sim and dDef_live (6 policies), with the exact one-sided permutation p-value over the 720 orderings (descriptive)
secondary pooled: tau-b over all non-default (cell, policy) points of dDef_sim vs dDef_live; and the mean of the per-cell taus
sensitivity: the same with the sim counterpart at k0-2 mean and at lag 10 ms and 50 ms
analysis.sign_agreement: per cell, sign(s(g_live(m1v2), g_live(ramjet))) vs sign(s(g_sim_k0(m1v2), g_sim_k0(ramjet))); reported for every cell; the count is taken over informative cells (|sim delta| > 0.01: all but sessions-s6), and separately over informative cells where |live delta| exceeds 2 x sqrt(2) x sigma_live
analysis.live_noise: per cell r(c) = s(g(default_a), g(default_b)) (within-job except the split sessions cell, flagged cross-node); sigma_live = sqrt(mean_c r(c)^2 / 2) estimates the per-run sd of ln goodput; reported next to every live delta (dDef sd ~ 1.22 sigma, dRj sd ~ 1.41 sigma)
analysis.calibration: g_live / g_sim_k0 per (cell, policy), as in the smoke (0.9976): absolute live-vs-sim goodput agreement, descriptive
wording_rules: the live ranking 'agrees' with simulation if the pooled tau-b >= 0.6 (at most 3 discordant of 15 pairs); otherwise state the disagreement and where it comes from

'M1-v2 > ramjet holds live' only if the live delta is positive in at least 2/3 of informative cells and its mean over informative cells is positive; otherwise report it as not reproduced (or reversed)
live results are validation only and never change selection, the headline or any frozen number; public text names no cluster, node, partition, account, job ID or internal path
analysis.completeness: a cell enters the per-cell and pooled tau only with all 6 policies valid; a cell missing one default uses the other (noise unmeasured there); partial cells are reported descriptively
